property_summary: Filling an order mints the maker's long/short NFT and mints the counterparty NFT (positionId) iff the signature is valid and other preconditions hold; when fillOrder returns a positionId it equals uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)).
If fillOrder returns without reverting then its returned positionId equals uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)).
Calling cancel(order) by the maker marks cancelledOrders[hashOrder(order)] = true (or the call reverts if msg.sender != order.maker).
After attempting to cancel(order), either the call reverts or cancelledOrders[hashOrder(order)] becomes true.
